name: statute
description: Laws that test themselves. Kane CLI walks your app like a real visitor; Statute checks what it recorded against the law.

scripts.check:consent: node bin/statute.js check consent --url http://localhost:4173 --start "node demo-store/server.js"
scripts.demo:fix: node bin/statute.js fix consent --url http://localhost:4173 --start "node demo-store/server.js" --app demo-store
scripts.demo:fix-cancel: node bin/statute.js fix cancel --url http://localhost:4173 --start "node demo-store/server.js" --app demo-store
scripts.demo:hax: node bin/statute.js fix consent --url http://localhost:8095/ --start "node bin/serve.js 8095 examples/haxcms" --app examples/haxcms
scripts.check:price: node bin/statute.js check price --url http://localhost:4173 --start "node demo-store/server.js"
scripts.demo:fix-price: node bin/statute.js fix price --url http://localhost:4173 --start "node demo-store/server.js" --app demo-store
